conviction_note: A pre-commercial CNS biotech whose Q3 release, by the company's own stated policy, should carry no regulatory news (PDUFAs 2026-12-27 and 2027-01-29, both outside the window), with Investor Day on 2026-11-12 also outside the window. The only thing that could make this print big is the EMERALD topline, guided to Q4 2026 and not yet out, which might ride in the release but more plausibly waits for Investor Day. So abs_move 7 (below the 15.65% option event move, which covers the Nov 20 expiry including Investor Day; above the 0.4-4% that non-regulatory prints have moved), and p_up 52 on small positioning tilts (Fidelity's stake up to 9.2%, about 13% of float short going into an Investor Day). The findings sum (+0.7) and the scaled number (+0.28) agree in sign and are both close to zero, as they should be.
bar: Q3 2026 GAAP EPS consensus about -$3.86 from ONE aggregator snippet (benzinga earnings-forecasts page via search, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/PRAX/earnings-forecasts, fetch refused with 403); FY2026 median -14.03 (chartmill, 21 analysts, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/PRAX/estimates, snippet only). Only one source for the quarter, so every size is capped small. The company gives no opex or revenue guide, only 'cash into 2028' (Q2 8-K https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001689548/000168954826000082/praxisq22026pr.htm). For context: Q2 net loss was $83.7m and Q2 EPS -$2.87 against a -$3.67 estimate. For this name the bar that matters is not EPS but whether the release carries pipeline or regulatory news.
positioning_check: Short interest: 3.7m shares at the 2026-08-14 FINRA settlement, 7.8 days to cover (11.3 at 2026-07-31); equibles puts it at 13.1% of float. Those figures are search snippets from curvedtrading/equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/prax/shortinterest); the curvedtrading and marketbeat pages returned 403, and I found nothing for October 2026. Shares outstanding were 27.9m at 2026-06-30. Holders: FMR's 13G/A filed 2026-11-05 shows 2,565,828 shares, 9.2%, as of 2026-09-30, against 1,353,275 shares, 5.4%, at 2025-12-31. Skew: 25-delta put minus call is +2.63 vol points, a mild downside lean. Put/call OI is 0.31 with total OI of only 2,353. The ATM spread is 24% of mid, so the 15.65% event move is noisy and spans Investor Day (2026-11-12). The 20-day run-up is +5.2%, the 5-day -4.39%, and the stock is 29% below its 52-week high of $392.70.

findings.finding: Relutrigine's EMERALD study is the one item that could make the Nov 9 release a large mover. It is a registrational 16-week placebo-controlled trial in broad DEEs, about 200 patients enrolled against a ~160 target, with topline guided to Q4 2026 in the Q2 8-K. I found no topline published as of 2026-11-06. It could appear in the 9 Nov release or at the Guggenheim fireside chat that morning (9:30 ET), but the 12 Nov Investor Day's announced 'pipeline update' is the more likely venue. Signless: it raises the size of the move, not its direction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Pipeline and regulatory news moves this name far more than the quarter does: 2025-02-28 Essential3 interim -40.6%; 2026-08-06 Q2 release carrying clean mid-cycle and BIMO results +15.95%; vormatrigine POWER1 miss about -12% after hours (rallies.ai, 2026-06-02). Prints with no pipeline content: -0.38% (2026-05-13), +0.81% (2026-02-19).
findings.why_not_priced: The option market carries it as unsigned variance. The Nov 20 straddle implies an 18.5% move, 15.65% net of ordinary vol, far above the 5.6% median past reaction, consistent with a data event priced somewhere in the next two weeks. What is not priced is the timing split between Nov 9 (inside this window) and Nov 12 (outside it).
findings.independence: The NeurologyLive article of 2026-09-27 (https://www.neurologylive.com/view/fda-extends-relutrigine-review-delays-pdufa-to-december) repeats the Q4 2026 topline and ~200 enrolled. The Investor Day agenda with its 'pipeline update' (https://www.biopharmawatch.com/news/PRAX/praxis-precision-medicines-q3-2026-results-investor-day) points to Nov 12 as the venue, which argues against Nov 9.

findings.finding: The company said in its Q2 release that it 'does not intend to communicate regulatory updates going forward until the expected PDUFA dates' (relutrigine 2026-12-27, ulixacaltamide 2027-01-29). So the Nov 9 release should be a cash and opex quarter with no FDA content, unlike the Aug 6 release whose mid-cycle and no-483 news drove +15.95%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Releases with no regulatory or data content: -0.38% (2026-05-13), +0.81% (2026-02-19), -4.14% (2025-11-05). The release carrying regulatory news moved +15.95% (2026-08-06).
findings.why_not_priced: This shapes the size, not the direction. If it were fully priced, the event move would sit near the 0.4-4% that non-regulatory prints have moved; instead it is 15.65%, which reflects the Investor Day and EMERALD inside the expiry rather than the release itself.
findings.independence: The search snippet summarising the 2026-08 update (https://rallies.ai/news/prax-climbs-as-fda-ulixacaltamide-nda-acceptance-keeps-regulatory-momentum-bid) restates the same no-updates policy, but it comes from the same company document.

findings.finding: Fidelity (FMR LLC) nearly doubled its stake: 2,565,828 shares (9.2%) at 2026-09-30, from 1,353,275 (5.4%) at 2025-12-31, per a 13G/A filed 2026-11-05. That makes a long-only holder the largest disclosed buyer into the PDUFA period.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: none found for holder filings on this name
findings.why_not_priced: It was filed the day before the seal and picked up by no wire I found. But it is backward-looking (through 2026-09-30), the stock has fallen about 6% since then, and part of the increase may be January follow-on allocation. It is a small tilt, not an edge.
findings.independence: The prior 13G/A (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1689548/000031506626000505/primary_doc.xml) is the comparison point, from the same filer.

findings.finding: Short interest of about 3.7m shares, roughly 13% of float and 7.8-11 days to cover at the July and August 2026 settlements, sits in a name heading into a scheduled Investor Day (Nov 12) and two PDUFAs. With no negative regulatory content expected on Nov 9, the shorts have a cover-ahead-of-events incentive inside the window.

findings.finding: Q3 EPS consensus is about -$3.86 (one source), which implies a net loss of roughly $110m against Q2's $83.7m (R&D $69.4m, G&A $27.5m, with sizeable interest income on $1.4bn cash). The company beat by about 22% in Q2 (-$2.87 against -$3.67) and in 3 of the last 4 quarters, so a smaller-than-modelled loss is likely.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 22% Q2 EPS beat coincided with +15.95%, but that move came from the regulatory news. The Q1 2026 beat moved -0.38%. EPS beats do not move this name.
findings.why_not_priced: Only partly unpriced: the bar is a single-source estimate, and for a pre-commercial biotech the market looks through opex. Capped small.
findings.independence: The beat track record comes from the barchart preview snippet (https://www.barchart.com/story/news/3585699/praxis-precision-medicines-enters-earnings-with-two-regulatory-dates-set-but-commercial-execution-remains-unproven), a different source from the 8-K.

outside_window.finding: Investor Day in New York, 2026-11-12 08:00 ET: launch-readiness presentations for both programs under FDA review, KOL panels and a pipeline update, likely where EMERALD or vormatrigine POWER2/3 news lands. It sits inside the Nov 20 option expiry and explains much of the 15.65% event move, but it falls after this trade's exit.

Relutrigine PDUFA for SCN2A/SCN8A DEE is 2026-12-27 (extended three months on a major amendment; mid-cycle showed no major concerns; no 483). Ulixacaltamide PDUFA is 2027-01-29 with no AdCom. Both are dated after the window.
